findings.detail: https://hq10000.com/knowledge/singapore-registration-guide, https://hq10000.com/knowledge. findings.title: Every page in the sitemap has the same lastmod
findings.detail: All 65 say 2026-09-16. That is a generator stamping build time rather than when each page last changed — which tells a crawler nothing, so it learns to ignore the field.
